xrz7a2r0.variantName: My Christmas 5ft Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with LED Lights - 150cm
xrz7a2r0.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of a snowy Christmas into your home with this 5ft artificial Christmas tree, featuring 550 lifelike branch tips made from a PE and PVC blend. The realistic foliage is enhanced with flocked snow accents to create a winter-inspired appearance, while the sturdy branches provide support for your favourite Christmas decorations. The integrated lights offer warm white and cool white options, with nine lighting effects to suit different festive settings. An included remote control allows you to switch between lighting modes conveniently. The fully hinged construction makes assembly and branch shaping straightforward, and the tree can be dismantled into four sections for easy storage after the festive season. A sturdy metal stand provides reliable stability, making this tree an attractive centrepiece for homes, offices and other indoor festive displays. Specifications: Made from PE and PVC with 550 lifelike branch tips and flocked snow accents. Features integrated lights with warm white and cool white settings, nine lighting effects and an included remote control. Fully hinged construction with four dismantlable sections and a sturdy metal stand. Dimensions: Height: 5ft (approximately 152cm). Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

v7dj870f.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Easy Assembly - White - 150 cm
v7dj870f.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Easy Assembly - White - 150 cm
v7dj870f.sourceDescription: This modern artificial Christmas tree exudes a sleek, contemporary style perfect for those who appreciate minimalistic elegance. Defined by its clean lines and functional design, this piece seamlessly blends into both indoor and outdoor settings, offering a sophisticated touch to your festive decor. Its attractive cone shape and warm LED lighting transform any space into a winter wonderland, creating a cozy atmosphere for families and guests. Materials: Constructed from high-quality PVC, this modern artificial Christmas tree provides a sense of real evergreen foliage without the maintenance of a live tree. The use of PVC ensures durability and a lifelike appearance that stays vibrant season after season. Its green hue complements any holiday decor with elegance. Included Components: Equipped with LED strip lights and a USB plug, this tree offers convenient, safe lighting. The LEDs emit a warm white glow, filling your space with an inviting ambiance. Easily adjustable, these lights let you craft the perfect atmosphere at your holiday gatherings. Decorative Features: This tree features simple yet striking decorations that enhance its sleek modern look. The decorative accents lend an air of elegance and sophistication, turning your living area or outdoor space into a holiday sanctuary. Recommended Uses: Ideal for various settings, from cozy living rooms to open terraces. Its compact yet prominent presence adapts beautifully to small spaces or as a centerpiece in larger rooms, offering flexibility in decorating styles. Care &Maintenance: For best results, cover the tree when not in use to protect from dust and debris. A certified 5V USB power source is required to operate the tree's LED lights, ensuring optimal performance throughout the holiday season. Product Specifications Colour: White PVC and plastic and steel and PE Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 63 cm Stand size: 35 x 35 cm Hinged Branches for Easy Setup Lifelike Tips Snow Flocked Number of PE tips: 130 Number of PVC tips: 345 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: LED strip lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 150 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Wattage: 5 W Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree 1 x Foldable stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

t41r5vmm.baseName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
t41r5vmm.variantName: Christmas Tree World 8ft Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
t41r5vmm.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this realistic 8ft Christmas tree. The Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations and Christmas tree lights. Our customers love how full and bushy the Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 8ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps). Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 8ft • Number of branch tips: 3554 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 160cm diameter • Foliage colour: Dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
